verdict.rationale: A direct probe shows no llms.txt (HTTP 404 at docs.riveterhq.com/llms.txt), and nothing in the pack documents agent-oriented docs as a feature. Riveter does publish an openapi.yaml and an MCP server, but those are a machine-readable API spec and a different integration channel, not docs meant to be handed to an agent, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
